repos.notes: Authors' own repo linked in the paper abstract. Contains TAPA-based HLS designs for NTT acceleration on FPGAs. The HLS scan classifies it as tapa_only (uses TAPA framework for task-parallel HLS). The repo is not a fork, was created right before the FCCM 2025 submission, and includes commits from the paper's first author (Dilshan Kumarathunga), second author (Qilin Hu), and last author (Zhenman Fang).

summary: Found the authors' own repo SFU-HiAccel/AutoNTT directly linked in the paper abstract (page 1) with 'AutoNTT will be released soon at https://github.com/SFU-HiAccel/AutoNTT'. The repo exists, contains TAPA-based HLS designs, has commits from authors Dilshan Kumarathunga, Qilin Hu, and Zhenman Fang, and its description matches the paper title exactly. The HLS scan classifies it as tapa_only (uses TAPA framework). The paper also builds on the TAPA framework (UCLA-VAST/tapa, cited as [32]), but this is a separate published framework and not reported as a third-party design repo per the guidelines. No other repos were identified as designs the paper builds on or evaluates with as subjects. Confidence is very high: the link is explicit in the paper body (not just references), and all repo metadata aligns perfectly.
